steps.speaker: Deranged Sinner
steps.content: Aaahhh—!!
"Her" wail sounds like a heart-wrenching cry. She continues to struggle, while the gigantic, twisted filth wrapped around her continues to squirm, but her lower body has already begun to fracture.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is the end for Sinners.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Doesn't she want to live on? She clearly still has many wishes.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's too late. Chief, end it all. Dragging it out will only be more painful.

steps.speaker: Deranged Sinner
steps.content: No! Go back, I want to go back!!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She's about to explode, Chief. Back off!!!
She pulls you back. At the same time, a white figure rushes past you into the raging contamination.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Anne?!!
Boom—!!

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: ...Made it...

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Great... I'm here... You're alive. See? The drug is working...

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: ...You're safe now... I'll save you...
The explosion tore through Anne's uniform. She is severely injured, yet she isn't treating herself. All the serum is used on the Sinner in her arms, whose body is frozen.
But it's only the pale, fractured remains. As if it is burnt to ashes, the body below the chest has shattered to pieces.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Let her go, the head nurse. The tissues of the Corruptors will cause massive contamination. Your mental state is already unstable.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: ...She is not a Corruptor. She is my patient.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She's dead.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: She'll come back. I can hear her. She says she doesn't want to die... I can hear them...

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: ...I promised to save you...

She carefully picks up the girl and slowly stands up. The cracked wall of the secret room reveals the deep space behind, where dozens of Corruptors are dunk in experimental containers, looking at you through the frosty glass.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Is this...?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content:
Collecting Corruptors and pollutants, and conducting forbidden research...
Chief, this is an A-class violation.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Ha—Hahahaha!! I told you! SALVA is collecting monsters. They're crazy! Heresy!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Accept it! There's no cure for Mania. The dead can never come back to life! You've already gone crazy, and you'll become like her sooner or later!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Let all Sinners go to hell!!

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: ...I will. For the unfulfilled promise and for seeing those I failed to save...
She walks toward the blue, ghostly death space. She needs to stop. She must be stopped!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, don't go there. That place and those things are dangerous.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: ...Chief, leave and continue your mission, will you?

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: This Mania isn't over yet. Go find the person you're looking for and stop more tragedies. We all have our duty.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: ...I don't want to fight you here.
Holding broken remains of Corruptors, she disappears among the eerie figures behind the wall. The door slowly closes.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Something is here... It's a monster born out of contamination.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Haha... Hahaha! How timely. It's time for me to go... I still have lots to do...

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I'll let you all die here with these monsters. You deserve it. You're monsters too! Go to hell, all of you! I'm the only one who can survive!
He flees away through the horde of monsters.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Those monsters didn't attack him... He's holding something in his hand!
This villain, this root of all evil. He plots for his ambitions, covets power, uses Sinners, and abuses others.
He is not a Sinner, yet he is more repulsive than any criminal.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Hecate, can you bring judgment on him?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: If that's your order.
